w10_T4_003817: Priya keeps her violin practice log in minutes, though she knows that sixty minutes make an hour and may convert it later. This week she practiced for 84 minutes on each of 3 mornings. In the afternoon her teacher reviewed the log, split that total into 2 equal parts, and said that only one of those parts counted as focused practice. That evening Priya compared notes with her cousin Dev, whose focused practice comes to 6 times her focused total, so Dev's amount is much larger than hers. If Dev keeps up that same amount for 3 weeks, how many minutes of focused practice will Dev log in total?
w10_T4_003819: Marco had 77 cents in his pocket when he walked into the corner shop. He counts his money in cents, though he knows that a hundred cents make a dollar. He spent 41 cents on a gumball and then 29 cents on a sticker. On the way home he dropped 6 cents down a storm drain. His grandmother, who had watched him save for a dozen days, promised to give him 6 times whatever he had left. How many cents will his grandmother give him?
w10_T4_003825: The Ridgeview school garden fund, which has been running for half a decade, started the year with 166 dollars collected from each of its 4 homerooms. The committee spent 119 dollars of the fund on seeds and tools. A local business then ran a matching campaign that left the fund 8 times as large as it had been. A grateful parent added another 79 dollars. The committee, which has 7 members, finally paid 3900 dollars out of the fund to install a greenhouse. How many dollars remain in the garden fund?
w10_T4_003836: On Saturday the Alvarez parents put 108 minutes of tablet time into a jar to be shared equally among their 4 children. Lena used 13 minutes of her share on a puzzle game and another 3 minutes checking the weather. Her brother Tomas had not touched his own share yet, so at that point Tomas had more time left than Lena. Lena then earned 51 extra minutes by washing the car, and in the evening her parents made whatever she had 2 times as large for a good report card. The family rule book, which runs to 9 pages, states limits in hours rather than minutes, so Lena had to remember that sixty minutes make an hour. How many minutes of tablet time does Lena have now?
w10_T4_003837: Nadia keeps track of the photos on her phone in megabytes, though she knows that a thousand megabytes make a gigabyte and her plan is billed in gigabytes. Her phone started the year with no photos on it. Every day of an 8-day holiday she added 21 megabytes of photos, and over the year she went on 4 holidays of exactly that pattern. Afterward she deleted 417 megabytes of blurry shots. Her sister then sent her 11 megabytes of group pictures, which she saved. How many megabytes of photos does Nadia have now?
w10_T4_003840: Farmer Ellis bought 5 packets of heirloom bean seeds, with 150 seeds in each packet, and that was his entire pile. He then found 58 more seeds left over from last year and added them to the pile. His garden has 11 raised beds. He planted every seed he had, and at harvest each seed he had planted gave back 5 seeds, all of which went into the pile. A neighbour gave him 15 seeds of the same variety. He then sold 1670 seeds at the market. How many bean seeds does Ellis have left?
w10_T4_003847: Dario belongs to a coffee shop rewards program and has been a member for half a year. He earned 170 points in each of the last 7 weeks. The shop, which has 3 locations in town, gave him a 48-point birthday bonus. A survey he filled out added another 13 points. He then redeemed 1200 points for a coffee grinder. How many points does Dario have left in his account?
w10_T4_003851: For a camping trip Priya and Sam packed trail mix, and they weigh everything in grams even though the campsite list is written in kilograms, so they remembered that a thousand grams make a kilogram. Into each bag Priya put 162 grams of nuts and Sam added 62 grams of chocolate chips, so Priya's share of every bag was heavier than Sam's. They packed 3 bags in each box and filled 5 boxes. Over the trip the group ate 1423 grams of the mix. On the last morning Sam found a spilled 45 grams in the bottom of the cooler and swept it back in. How many grams of trail mix are left?
w10_T4_003853: Rosa earned 205 dollars in each of the 4 weeks of June. Her roommate Kei earned the same 205 dollars a week but keeps all of it in one envelope, so Kei's envelope holds more than any of Rosa's. Rosa split her June earnings equally among 4 envelopes labelled rent, groceries, savings and fun. She then divided the fun envelope equally across the 5 weekends in July. Rosa's cousin also mailed her a 20-dollar gift card, which she is saving for December. For the first July weekend Kei chipped in 5 dollars so they could share a pizza. How many dollars does Rosa have to spend on that first weekend?
w10_T4_003855: The Hollis brickyard, open for a dozen years, was completely empty at the start of the week. A pallet holds 192 bricks, each delivery truck carries 9 pallets, and 5 trucks arrive every day. Over 4 days the yard received deliveries at that rate and stacked every brick in its stock. Ada, the yard manager, then found 35 loose bricks behind the office and added them to the stock. A builder named Ben bought 16486 bricks for a housing project, an amount vastly larger than Ada's little pile. How many bricks remain in the yard's stock?
w10_T4_003862: Ida runs the loading dock at a hardware warehouse and was packing a single order of screws. In the morning she packed 114 screws into each small box and 9 boxes into each carton, then had every carton split into 2 equal halves so the halves would fit on the conveyor. In the afternoon 4 half-cartons went into each crate and 6 crates were stacked on each pallet. In the evening 5 full pallets were loaded onto the truck for the customer, Ravi. Ravi later sent back 43062 screws that were the wrong thread size, so Ida's shipment was far larger than Ravi's return. How many screws did Ravi keep?
w10_T4_003878: Each morning Tara's first oven tray comes out with 102 bread rolls, but today 22 of them were burnt and thrown away, and then 66 rolls from the next batch were added to the tray. She filled 4 trays to that same count and divided all of those rolls equally among 4 delivery baskets. Her rival Bruno still packs only 102 rolls per basket, so each of Tara's baskets holds more than one of Bruno's. Tara delivers one such basket to the Grand Hotel on each of 5 days, and the hotel chef records bread by the dozen rather than by the roll and converts the count later. For a banquet the hotel also ordered 24 extra rolls. How many rolls did the Grand Hotel receive from Tara in total?
w10_T4_003887: Ravi and Mia ran a raffle table at the town fair, starting the morning with 145 tickets. In the morning Ravi sold 45 tickets. In the afternoon Mia sold 28 tickets, and it took her nearly half an hour to sell the first one. In the evening Ravi sold 56 more, so Ravi's evening sales beat Mia's afternoon sales. The leftover tickets were split equally among the 4 volunteers, and Mia was one of them. Mia gave 3 of her tickets to her nephew. How many tickets does Mia have left?
w10_T4_003889: On Monday morning Farmer Hale collected 147 eggs and sold 90 of them at the farm gate. In the afternoon her nephew Theo collected 65 more, though Theo's haul was smaller than Hale's morning collection. In the evening she divided all the eggs on hand into 2 equal crates, keeping one crate for the Saturday stall. Hale sends 6 crates of that same size to the stall every week and keeps that up for 9 weeks. The stall ledger counts eggs in dozens rather than singles, so the clerk converts the numbers at the end. How many eggs in total does Hale send to the stall over those 9 weeks?
w10_T4_003902: In the morning Mrs. Ortiz set out 137 peaches on her market stall. By noon she had sold 115 of them. In the afternoon a customer bought a dozen for a pie. Her son then brought 17 more peaches from the orchard and added them to the stall. In the evening she found 8 bruised peaches and threw them away. How many peaches are on the stall now?
w10_T4_003904: The Pinecrest office paper supply is kept in a cupboard. Each opened ream in the cupboard held 195 sheets, and Marcus tucked 5 loose sheets into each one. There were 4 such reams, and together they made up the whole supply. A colleague returned 47 sheets she had borrowed. The Monday report used up 498 sheets, and the Tuesday mailing used another 108. How many sheets are left in the paper supply?
w10_T4_003905: The Chen family set aside 114 dollars for a picnic. They spent 86 dollars on food and 16 dollars on drinks, and the leftover was split equally among the 6 children as pocket money. Mei, the youngest, decided to save her share, and her parents made that same amount her weekly pocket money, so she saved every payment for 9 weeks. Her grandmother, who still thinks in cents and reminded her that a hundred cents make a dollar, then added 40 dollars to Mei's savings. How many dollars does Mei have saved?
w10_T4_003913: Dana runs a lemonade stall at a market whose till counts in cents, so she converts every hundred cents into a dollar when she writes up her book in dollars. In the morning the stall took 88 dollars, and 58 dollars more came in before noon. In the afternoon it took 67 dollars, and in the evening another 42 dollars. She took exactly that same daily amount on each of the 6 days the market ran. All of that money was shared equally among the 6 members of her co-op, and Raj, another member, received exactly the same share as Dana. Dana then paid 245 dollars for next week's lemons and sugar. How many dollars does Dana have left from her share?
w10_T4_003925: Hana and Ken run a popcorn stand and keep their accounts in cents, converting to dollars only at the end of the month since a hundred cents make a dollar. On Monday they sold 6 bags at 232 cents each, found 48 cents in the tip cup, and were paid 60 cents for a spare paper cup. They split the day's money equally between the 2 of them. Hana spent 274 cents of her share on the bus home, while Ken spent nothing, so Ken ended the day with more than Hana. Hana ended up with exactly that same amount on each of 8 days and saved all of it. How many cents did Hana save over those 8 days?
w10_T4_003932: The community garden rain barrel held 200 litres on Monday, and the volunteers measure it in litres even though the pump dial reads in millilitres, a thousand of which make a litre. They drew off 46 litres for the tomato beds, and a light drizzle added 7 litres. A storm that night tripled the amount in the barrel. On Wednesday they used 322 litres to soak the new orchard. Marisol worked out that the amount now left is exactly what the garden needs each week, and she wants to plan for 9 weeks. How many litres of water does the garden need for those 9 weeks?
w10_T4_003935: A juice bar is preparing an order and tracks it in millilitres, converting to litres only on the invoice, since a thousand millilitres make a litre. Each bottle is filled with 197 millilitres of orange juice and then topped up with 60 millilitres of mango puree. A crate holds 6 of these bottles, and a 13-millilitre sample vial is tucked into every crate as well. The order calls for 8 full crates, which took the staff half a day to prepare. How many millilitres of juice and puree are in the whole order?
w10_T4_003944: Zara is in charge of the flyer stack for the summer festival, and the printer delivered 8 bundles with 171 flyers in each to make up the whole stack. Leo handed out 1135 flyers from the stack on the first day. Zara then printed 6 fresh flyers for every flyer still in the stack and replaced the old ones with them, so the stack held only the new prints. The festival has 4 stages. On the second day Zara handed out 609 flyers herself, far fewer than Leo had managed. For the final weekend she printed enough to make the stack 3 times as large. How many flyers are in the stack now?
w10_T4_003951: Ivy ordered craft beads from a supplier named Ben, who has run his warehouse for a dozen years. Each pack holds 43 beads, 6 packs go into a box, and 6 boxes go into a carton. Ben also drops 31 loose beads into every carton as a bonus, which is fewer beads than a single pack holds. The beads come in 5 colours. A pallet carries 8 cartons, and Ivy's order is for 9 pallets. How many beads will Ivy receive in total?
w10_T4_003955: Nia had 93 minutes before dinner to finish her homework, while her brother Eli had only 45 minutes for his, so Nia had the longer stretch of time. Her math sheet took her 27 minutes. Her mother then pushed dinner back and gave Nia 10 extra minutes. Nia spent 52 minutes on an essay and 15 minutes on her reading log, then 4 minutes packing her bag. She keeps her timer in minutes, though she knows sixty minutes make an hour and could convert it. How many minutes does Nia have left before dinner?
w10_T4_003957: Priya is collecting ribbon for a costume and measures it in centimetres, though the pattern lists lengths in metres and she knows a hundred centimetres make a metre. She began with 146 centimetres of blue ribbon and cut off 16 centimetres for a bookmark. At the fabric shop, after waiting half an hour in line, she bought a 51-centimetre piece. Her aunt gave her a 32-centimetre piece and a 34-centimetre piece from her sewing box. How many centimetres of ribbon does Priya have now?
